**Root cause: Vault Kubernetes auth returning 403 for all new pod authentication attempts.**

The 3.9.0 pod (`orders-api-5b4d7c8f9-hn6wd`) is stuck at `Init:0/1` because its `vault-agent-init` init container cannot complete. A pod cannot become Ready until all init containers succeed [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers#understanding-init-containers-0], and this one is looping indefinitely because Vault is rejecting every login attempt.

**Evidence from vault-agent-init logs:**
```
[ERROR] agent.auth.handler: error authenticating: error="Error making API request.
URL: PUT https://vault.sec.internal:8200/v1/auth/kubernetes-prod/login
Code: 403. Errors: * permission denied" backoff=...
```
This has been happening since 13:00:41 (the moment the pod started) and is still occurring at 5-minute back-off intervals.

The 3.8.0 pods (`orders-api-7c9f8d6b5-tq4lm` and `orders-api-7c9f8d6b5-zr8wc`) are unaffected because they authenticated successfully 6 days ago and hold valid Vault tokens. Any new pod (including any future 3.9.0 rollout) must authenticate from scratch and will hit the same 403.

The service account (`orders-api`), namespace (`orders`), Vault role (`orders-api`), and auth path (`auth/kubernetes-prod`) are identical between 3.8.0 and 3.9.0, so the application image change is not the direct cause — something on the Vault side changed after the 3.8.0 pods were scheduled.

**Fix — action required from the security team (Vault owners):**
1. Check the `orders-api` Vault role at `auth/kubernetes-prod/role/orders-api` to confirm `bound_service_account_names` still includes `orders-api` and `bound_service_account_namespaces` still includes `orders`.
2. Verify the `token_reviewer_jwt` configured for the `kubernetes-prod` auth method is still valid and has not been rotated or expired (a stale reviewer JWT causes 403 for all new logins without affecting existing sessions).
3. Check Vault audit logs for entries at ~13:00 today for clues about what policy or role attribute is denying the request.

Once the Vault-side configuration is corrected, the stuck pod will authenticate and start normally on its next retry (currently backing off at 5-minute intervals). If you want to speed it up, delete and re-create the 3.9.0 ReplicaSet/Deployment rollout after the Vault fix is confirmed.
